Issues are public, so please leave out tokens, tenant IDs and customer details.

Do not post questions, answers or remembered topics from a live exam. Microsoft's exam security policy prohibits it:

## What Kind of Issue Is This?

<!-- Mark one with an x. -->

- [ ] **Content error:** text, a table, a callout or a command is wrong
- [ ] **Outdated content:** Copilot or its plans have changed since this was written
- [ ] **Exam coverage:** the notes don't match the official study guide
- [ ] **Site bug:** search, navigation, floating buttons, a broken link or accessibility
- [ ] **Device issue:** something looks wrong or doesn't work on a specific device, browser or screen size
- [ ] **Suggestion:** something could be clearer or easier to study

## Where?

<!-- Paste a link to the page or section. On most pages you can click the section in "On This Page", then copy the address bar. -->

## What Is Wrong?

<!-- Quote what the notes say, or describe what happened. For a bug or device issue, list the steps to reproduce it. -->

## What Should It Be?

<!-- Give the correct information, or what you expected to happen. -->

## Official Source

<!-- For content issues, link to the page that supports this, such as the GitHub Copilot docs (https://docs.github.com/en/copilot) or the study guide (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/credentials/certifications/resources/study-guides/gh-300). -->

## Device and Browser

<!-- For site bugs and device issues only. Include the device, operating system, browser and orientation, for example: Safari on iPhone 15, portrait, or Edge on Windows 11. -->
